concepts.name: Scribble Fox
concepts.subject: A tiny mischievous orange fox companion with oversized pointed ears, cream muzzle and chest, stubby black paws, expressive dark eyes and a HUGE fluffy tail ending in a black paintbrush tip. Lime-green glowing ink marks float behind its brush tail. Playful low crouch ready to pounce, cheeky grin. Small arcing green ink swoosh suggests Ink Pounce. Extremely cute, compact memorable silhouette, no clothes or weapons.

concepts.name: Puddle
concepts.subject: A tiny mint-green axolotl healer companion floating inside a perfectly clear wobbling water bubble. Rounded head, tiny feet, fluffy pink external gills, shiny dark eyes and gentle happy smile. Small cream medical satchel with a simple pink heart symbol (no red-cross emblem). One flipper releases a small glowing heart-shaped healing bubble. Lovable gentle personality, slightly puffed cheeks, cute round silhouette.

concepts.name: Chomp Chest
concepts.subject: A tiny friendly animated wooden treasure-chest companion with warm honey oak planks, dark iron corner bands, brass latch shaped like a small star, two expressive jewel-like eyes set into the front. Four stubby little walking feet. Lid opens as a goofy smiling mouth with rounded friendly teeth and a long curling tongue made from an old cream treasure map with simple dotted trail (NO readable text). Chewing a harmless little bolt; a few gold repair sparks rise from mouth. Cheeky eager pet personality, compact and cute rather than scary mimic monster.

concepts.name: Orbit
concepts.subject: A tiny sleepy purple space-turtle companion paddling gently through the air. Soft lavender face and limbs, half-lidded friendly dark eyes, tiny smile. Its shell is a miniature deep-violet PLANET with glowing craters, little cyan and pink land masses, and a thin GOLD ORBITAL RING around the shell. Four star-shaped flippers, two little star particles orbiting it. A subtle curved cyan gravity ribbon suggests its ability to bend incoming objects. Dreamy lovable personality, very readable rounded silhouette.
